checks: With s=√3 the source coordinates x=(s−1)/2 and z=(3−s)/4 are positive and x+2z=1. Independent arithmetic in the field with s²=3 verifies (s/2)x=z and x²=z(1−1/s), so every prescribed affine margin vanishes at p.

Each coefficient of (2/3)f₁+f₂/s+f₃ is zero by x(1+1/s)=s/3 and 1/s²=1/3. All coefficients in the dependence are strictly positive. On the reference triangle (0,0),(1,0),(0,1) the first two gradients have determinant 1+s>0, agreeing with the proof's nonproportionality argument. Under the nonsingular affine map to any specified triangle, the gradients transform invertibly and normalized areas and incidence are unchanged.

At P₁,P₂,P₃ the first margin has signs (+,0,−), with boundary along P₂ and the second edge hit strictly inside P₁P₃. Its normalized area is 1·s/(s+2), which equals 2s−3 because (2s−3)(s+2)=s. The second row has signs (−,+,−), with exact edge fractions 2x and 2z checked by multiplying them by 1+x and 1+1/s, respectively. Both fractions are strictly in (0,1), and 4xz=2s−3. Exchanging vertices P₂ and P₃ gives the third cap and the same area.

Each closed cap contains p on the actual line fᵢ=0 and uses the sign orientation of its displayed normal. The zero vertex belongs to the first closed cap, thereby violating the strict exclusion conclusion at the common ceiling. This construction proves the endpoint failure independently of the strict theorem.
Source ca9f00bdb64d6d9e §4 explicitly gives the same barycentric point, margins, positive weights, incidence and all three cap fractions. The normalized proof supplies direct rank and area checks.

overlap.comparison: Its equality example uses a triangle centroid with cap fraction 4/9 for different sector inequalities. Each such cut strictly separates its chosen vertex from the other two, so it does not give the endpoint boundary incidence.
Its common-area example is an actual trapezoid and the conclusion is a radial triangle sector. It supplies no triangular-body witness at the sharp endpoint.
Treats zero vertex heights for an ordinary-area plus source-credit lower bound, without constructing or identifying the equal-fraction boundary cap menu in this claim.

readability: The determinant check is independent of the shorter proportionality argument in the proof. All edge-intercept fractions are measured from the strictly captured vertex.
review_method: Independent mathematical proof review of the frozen normalized candidate
summary: The frozen formulas give an actual interior source and three rank-two, positively dependent closed caps on every nondegenerate planar triangle. All three fractions are exactly 2√3−3 and the first cutting line contains the second vertex.
